battle.name: 納戈爾諾-卡拉巴赫戰爭
battle.brief: 納戈爾諾-卡拉巴赫戰爭始於2020年2月，是亞美尼亞與亞塞拜然圍繞納戈爾諾-卡拉巴赫及周邊地區的武裝衝突。亞塞拜然調動BM-21「Grad」多管火箭炮參戰，該型號於1967年列裝，以車載發射系統提供遠距火箭火力，是此次地面作戰中可辨識的蘇聯時期裝備。

kit.name: BM-21「Grad」多管火箭炮
kit.history: BM-21「Grad」是蘇聯陸軍炮兵體系中的122毫米多管火箭炮，負責提供較炮兵射程更遠的火箭火力，並與自行加榴炮共同構成縱深打擊能力。

countries: 2020年納戈爾諾-卡拉巴赫戰役的一方是亞塞拜然及其武裝部隊，另一方是亞美尼亞武裝力量與亞爾斯赫克國防軍。亞塞拜然由賈姆賈、托武茲等西部師區，以及與亞爾斯赫克相接的北部、東部和南部方向部署，攻勢跨越約三百公里的接觸線。亞美尼亞本土軍與亞爾斯赫克部隊依托山脊、峽谷、疊堡、反坦克壕和縱深陣地作戰。俄羅斯在開火時不是參戰國，先以調解者身分斡旋，停火後又依協議向亞爾斯赫克及拉欖走廊一線派遣維和部隊；土耳其沒有地面參戰，但在戰前與戰時向亞塞拜然提供TB2無人機。亞爾斯赫克的代表不是亞美尼亞首都當局，而是其總統與國防部長，因此10月26日安排是三方都能執行的停火文件，而不是單純的兩國交換聲明。多數接觸面地形破碎，一處缺口可能牽動後方道路，但能否持續推進仍取決於山區通行、守軍封閉缺口的能力和後備部隊抵達速度。
countriesEn: The belligerent on one side in the 2020 Nagorno-Karabakh War was Azerbaijan and its armed forces; the other side was the Armed Forces of Armenia and the Artsakh Defense Army. Azerbaijan deployed from western districts such as Ganja and Tovuz and from northern, eastern, and southern sectors adjoining Artsakh, with its offensive spanning a contact line of roughly 300 kilometres. Armenian and Artsakh forces fought from ridgelines, valleys, overlapping strongpoints, anti-tank ditches, and in-depth positions in the mountains. Russia was not a belligerent when the shooting began; it first acted as mediator and later deployed peacekeepers to Artsakh and the Lachin corridor area under the agreement. Turkey did not enter the ground war, but supplied TB2 drones to Azerbaijan before and during the fighting. Artsakh was represented not by Armenia's government in Yerevan but by its own president and defense minister, so the arrangement of October 26 was a three-party enforceable ceasefire document rather than a simple bilateral statement. Most sectors of contact were physically fragmented, and one breach could affect roads behind the front, but actual progress depended on mountain access, the defenders' ability to close gaps, and the speed with which reserves could arrive.
people: 伊利亞姆·阿利耶夫以亞塞拜然總統與最高統帥身分發動攻勢，9月27日公開宣布全面進攻，10月8日宣布單方面停火以赴莫斯科會談，10月18日再要求亞方全面撤出特定區域，10月20日前後接受暫停交火的政治框架。國防部長扎基爾·胡塞因諾夫把政治決策轉成軍令，並代表亞塞拜然簽署10月26日文件；總參謀長魯斯坦·奧魯若夫與陸軍司令伊斯梅爾·穆薩耶夫分別統籌參謀作業和地面突擊。亞美尼亞總理尼科爾·帕希尼揚掌握談判立場，國防部長阿爾茨倫·薩爾基揚與總參謀長阿肖特·馬努基揚負責亞美尼亞本土軍。亞爾斯赫克總統薩姆維爾·沙赫拉馬尼揚與國防部長賈米爾·拜拉馬揚決定亞爾斯赫克防軍的撤出與停火，亞爾森·哈魯秋尼揚則參與前線軍事指揮。公開可核對的資料大多停留在軍團、旅和防區層級，因此不把無法確認的個人戰功或臨時指揮 命令寫成事實。亞美尼亞本土軍與亞爾斯赫克防軍分屬不同指揮系統，撤軍、後備部隊和火力協調必須經過額外層級，這也是缺口擴大後難以立即堵住的原因之一。
peopleEn: President and commander-in-chief Ilham Aliyev initiated the offensive, publicly announcing a broad attack on September 27, a unilateral cessation intended to facilitate talks in Moscow on October 8, and renewed demands for Armenian withdrawal from specified districts on October 18, before accepting the political framework for a temporary halt around October 20. Defense Minister Zakir Huseynov converted political decisions into operational orders and signed the October 26 document for Azerbaijan. Chief of the General Staff Rustam Orujov and Ground Forces commander Ismayil Musayev directed staff operations and the ground offensive respectively. Armenian prime minister Nikol Pashinyan set the negotiating position, while defense minister Artsrun Sargsyan and Chief of the General Staff Ashot Manukyan oversaw the Armenian armed forces. Artsakh president Samvel Shahramanyan and defense minister Jamil Bayramyan decided on the withdrawal and ceasefire of the Artsakh Defense Army, with Arsen Harutyunyan participating in front-line military command. Publicly verifiable information is concentrated at corps, brigade, and sector level, so unconfirmed individual exploits or improvised commands are not treated as facts. The Armenian armed forces and the Artsakh Defense Army belonged to separate command systems, making the coordination of withdrawals, reserves, and fires require additional levels. That structure was one reason gaps could widen after they appeared before they could be sealed.
kits: 公開影像與官方裝備資料顯示，亞塞拜然在2020年可投入的裝甲包括蘇聯製T-72B主戰坦克、土耳其製M60T3主戰坦克、M113T裝甲運兵車及BMP系列裝甲車；亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克則以T-72B、BMP-2、BMP-3和BTR系列裝甲車構成主要地面突擊與防禦力量。雙方可辨識的代表性火力包括152毫米2S19 Msta-S與2S22 DANA自行榴彈炮、122毫米BM-21 Grad火箭炮，以及部分單位的BM-27 Uragan 300毫米火箭炮，實際使用仍受彈藥存量、射程和射界限制。亞塞拜然部署有S-300PT、S-300V與9K33 Osa防空系統，亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克可見S-300Ts、S-300V、9K37 Buk-M1與9K33 Osa。這些飛彈系統主要提供防區和後方掩護，不能單憑配備表推算實際攔截戰果。土耳其於2020年交付亞塞拜然的Bayraktar TB2可攜帶MAM-L導引炸藥，用於偵察及攻擊暴露的砲位、通訊與車隊；亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克大量使用的Lancet-3巡飛彈則以小型防護據點和移動中的裝甲目標為主。這些型號在2020年以前均已列裝。考量雷區與反坦克壕，装甲車輛通常只沿已勘察的短距離道路轉移，油料與散熱／戰備物資留在後方，長時間停留的砲兵和後勤單位因而更容易受到無人機觀察與反砲兵火力的威脅。
kitsEn: Public imagery and official inventories show that Azerbaijan could field Soviet T-72B main battle tanks, Turkish M60T3 main battle tanks, Turkish M113T armoured personnel carriers, and BMP-series vehicles. Armenia and Artsakh relied mainly on T-72B tanks, BMP-2 and BMP-3 infantry fighting vehicles, and BTR-series vehicles for assault and defence. Representative fires identifiable on both sides included 152 mm 2S19 Msta-S and 2S22 DANA self-propelled howitzers, 122 mm BM-21 Grad launchers, and, in some units, BM-27 Uragan 300 mm rocket launchers; their actual use remained constrained by ammunition stocks, range, and firing sectors. Azerbaijan operated S-300PT, S-300V, and 9K33 Osa air-defence systems, while Armenia and Artsakh fielded S-300Ts, S-300V, 9K37 Buk-M1, and 9K33 Osa systems. These missile systems principally protected sectors and rear areas, and their presence alone does not establish interception results. Turkey delivered Bayraktar TB2 drones to Azerbaijan in 2020; the aircraft could carry MAM-L guided munitions and were used for reconnaissance and strikes against exposed artillery, communications, and vehicle columns. Lancet-3 loitering munitions used by Armenia and Artsakh were particularly effective against small protected positions and moving armoured targets. Every model named here had entered service before the end of 2020. Because of minefields and anti-tank ditches, armoured vehicles usually moved only along surveyed routes over short distances, while fuel and sustainment stocks remained farther to the rear. Artillery and logistics units that stayed in one place for long periods were therefore more exposed to drone observation and counter-battery fire.
tactics: 9月27日天亮前，亞塞拜然在托武茲、巴爾達、哈德魯特、菲祖利與卡拉巴赫東側等多個地段實施砲火準備，TB2觀察、無人機偵察和地面突擊相互銜接。雙方對哪一方首先開火的說法不一，可以確認的是亞方隨即由多個方向展開進攻。巴爾達方向承受最早的主要突破壓力，亞塞拜然的砲兵先打擊塹壕、疊堡和周邊高地，T-72B、M60T3與裝甲運兵車再以短距離移動配合步兵接近，至9月28日，巴爾達市中心及附近主要陣地已由亞塞拜然控制。9月29日至30日，亞塞拜然把攻勢擴展為三條主要軸線：西北面指向卡爾巴賈爾與拉欖，南面壓向哈德魯特與菲祖利，東面則向馬爾塔克爾特及卡拉巴赫縱深推進。亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克以T-72B和BMP系列裝甲車在部分地段反擊，並利用後方砲兵支援受威脅陣地，但多個突破口同時出現，守軍無法在一夜之間全部封閉。地理定位影片可確認TB2曾攻擊或偵察多個砲位、通訊節點和車隊，卻不足以支持雙方公布的每一筆裝備損失。10月1日至4日，亞塞拜然把已突破地區當成後續出發點，反覆以短距離炮擊、固定陣地和裝甲輸送隊交替推進，並控制通往馬爾塔克爾特的部分道路。亞美尼亞投入預備兵力試圖恢復縱深道路，阿格達姆與哈德魯特方向的防線因連續遷移而拉長；卡拉巴赫方向的守軍則退守較高陣地，繼續以反坦克壕、地雷和相互支援的火力點遲滯裝甲車。10月4日以後，亞塞拜然再次發動廣泛攻勢，一面向卡爾巴賈爾施壓，一面在阿格達姆以南及舒沙周圍縮短控制區，另一面鞏固通往馬爾塔克爾特方向的突破口。10月5日至7日的主要特徵不是單純坦克正面衝撞，而是攻方奪取路口和高地、守方逐點後撤、再由步兵與工兵清理狹窄通道的連續作戰。10月8日18時，亞塞拜然宣布暫停攻擊，莫斯科會談於9日舉行；由於沒有形成可核驗的撤軍與安全安排，交火在10日恢復。10月15日再度會談，10月18日至20日仍有最後一輪多軸進攻及短暫停火。10月20日以後，零星砲火與談判交替進行，軍事位置沒有立即回到9月27日狀態。10月26日各方簽署停火文件後，主要砲火停止，山區陣地、撤軍路線和戰俘交換才依協議進入實際執行階段。
tacticsEn: Before dawn on September 27, Azerbaijan conducted artillery preparation across the Tovuz, Barda, Hadrut, Fizuli, and eastern Qarabağ sectors, with TB2 observation, drone reconnaissance, and ground assaults closely linked. The sides disagreed over who had fired first, but it is clear that Azerbaijan then advanced along several axes. The Barda front bore the first major breach. Azerbaijani artillery struck trench lines, overlapping strongpoints, and surrounding heights; T-72B and M60T3 tanks and armoured personnel carriers then advanced in short movements behind infantry. By September 28, Barda's centre and most nearby positions were under Azerbaijani control. From September 29 to 30, Azerbaijan expanded the offensive into three principal axes: toward Kalbajar and Lachin in the northwest, toward Hadrut and Fizuli in the south, and toward Martakert and the interior of Qarabağ in the east. Armenian and Artsakh forces counterattacked with T-72B tanks and BMP-series vehicles in several sectors and supported threatened positions with rearward artillery, but simultaneous openings could not all be sealed in a single night. Geolocated footage confirmed that TB2 aircraft observed or struck multiple artillery positions, communications nodes, and vehicle columns, although it could not validate every equipment-loss claim announced by either side. From October 1 to 4, Azerbaijan used captured ground as the starting point for subsequent attacks, alternating short artillery bursts, fixed-position assaults, and armoured transport movements while taking control of sections of the road to Martakert. Armenia committed reserves to restore routes into the interior, and the defensive line around Aghdam and Hadrut stretched through repeated relocations. In the Qarabağ sector, defenders withdrew to higher ground and continued to delay armour with anti-tank ditches, mines, and mutually supporting firing positions. After October 4, Azerbaijan launched another broad offensive, pressing toward Kalbajar, shortening its control around Aghdam in the south and Shusha, and consolidating penetrations toward Martakert. From October 5 to 7, the pattern was less a single frontal tank charge than a sequence in which attackers seized junctions and heights, defenders withdrew position by position, and infantry and engineers then cleared narrow routes. At 18:00 on October 8, Azerbaijan announced a pause, followed by talks in Moscow on October 9. Fighting resumed on October 10 because no verifiable withdrawal and security arrangement had been completed. Further talks took place on October 15, and another series of attacks and temporary halts occurred from October 18 to 20. Sporadic fire and negotiations alternated after October 20, and the military positions did not immediately return to those of September 27. The ceasefire document signed on October 26 ended the main artillery conflict, after which positions, withdrawal routes, and exchanges of prisoners entered the implementation stage.
data: 主要戰鬥從2020年9月27日延續至10月26日，按日曆日計算約三十日；部分文獻把停火後的俘虜交換、屍體搜尋與協議執行期一併計算，因而稱為四十四日戰爭。這項名稱反映不同計日方式，不代表另有一場戰役。接觸線全長約三百公里，但有效突破集中於巴爾達、阿格達姆、菲祖利、哈德魯特、卡爾巴賈爾、拉欖及馬爾塔克爾特等方向。9月28日前後巴爾達的控制權改變可由衛星影像與戰報互相印證；10月初通往馬爾塔克爾特的道路曾中斷，舒沙與馬爾塔克爾特周邊據點也陸續易手，但不同據點並非同一日失守。亞塞拜然官方使用的軍人傷亡數字為2,894人死亡、9,557人受傷；亞美尼亞在停火前曾公布989名軍人死亡、超過2,000人受傷，亞爾斯赫克防軍另以自身指揮鏈發布軍人數字。各方統計時間、納入範圍和更新方式不同，無法可靠相加，也沒有國際共同核驗的總表，因此本紀錄不把失蹤直接算作死亡，也不替任何一方推算精確總和。裝備方面可以確認若干陣地和車輛被放棄或摧毀，但公開影像不足以建立完整的逐件損失表。
dataEn: The principal combat phase lasted from September 27 to October 26, 2020, or about thirty calendar days. Some accounts also count the post-ceasefire exchanges of prisoners, recovery of remains, and implementation of agreements, and therefore call it a forty-four-day war. That name reflects different counting conventions rather than the existence of another campaign. The contact line was about 300 kilometres long, but effective penetrations were concentrated around Barda, Aghdam, Fizuli, Hadrut, Kalbajar, Lachin, and Martakert. Changes in control around Barda by September 28 can be cross-checked through satellite imagery and operational reporting. In early October, the road toward Martakert was interrupted, while positions around Shusha and Martakert changed hands successively rather than on a single day. The official Azerbaijani military casualty figures were 2,894 dead and 9,557 wounded. Before the ceasefire, Armenia reported 989 military personnel dead and more than 2,000 wounded, while Artsakh authorities issued separate military figures through their own chain of command. The sides used different reporting dates, inclusion rules, and updates, so the totals cannot be reliably added, and there is no internationally verified common table. Missing personnel are therefore not automatically counted as dead, and no definitive combined total is inferred. Open-source evidence confirms that some positions and vehicles were abandoned or destroyed, but it is insufficient for a complete item-by-item loss list.
cause: 戰爭的遠因是亞塞拜然、亞美尼亞及亞爾斯赫克之間從未解決的主權、邊界與安全安排問題。1988年至1994年的戰爭結束後，雙方接受停火，卻沒有達成永久政治協議。1994年停火後，亞美尼亞部隊仍控制阿格達姆、薩爾桑格與貝爾達申等亞塞拜然西部區域，這些突出部被亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克視為保護本國及亞爾斯赫克的安全屏障，亞塞拜然則堅持不得接受這種現狀。歐安組織明斯克小組長期談判未能確定最終地位，接觸線上的砲火、小規模滲透和违及停火的事件則持續發生。2020年7月24日至26日，托武茲方向再度發生戰鬥，雙方各自指責對方先攻擊並違反停火，事件加深國內政治壓力，也讓外交談判更難維持現狀。外部援助改變了雙方對風險的計算：亞塞拜然獲得土耳其無人機及較強的遠程火力，亞美尼亞則依靠俄羅斯基地與軍事支持維持北部邊境安全。8月至9月的接觸線談判未產生可核驗的撤軍方案。從公開聲明和部署可見，亞塞拜然認為有限攻勢可在國際介入前奪取特定區域，亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克則把同一批陣地視為不可退讓的縱深，雙方對戰役代價與勝負門檻的估算因而朝相反方向移動。
causeEn: The deeper causes were unresolved questions of sovereignty, borders, and security among Azerbaijan, Armenia, and Artsakh. The 1988-1994 war ended with an accepted ceasefire but no final political settlement. After the 1994 ceasefire, Armenian forces continued to hold areas in western Azerbaijan, including the salient around Aghdam, Sarsang, and Berdashen. Armenia and Artsakh regarded positions of this kind as security barriers for Armenia and Artsakh, while Azerbaijan rejected the post-war arrangement. The OSCE Minsk Group never settled the final status issue, while artillery fire, small infiltrations, and ceasefire violations continued along the contact line. Fighting in the Tovuz direction on July 24-26, 2020, brought mutual accusations of first attack and ceasefire violations, increased domestic political pressure, and made diplomatic management of the existing situation more difficult. External assistance altered each side's calculation of risk. Azerbaijan obtained Turkish drones and stronger long-range firepower, while Armenia relied on the Russian base and Russian military support for the security of its northern border. Contact-line talks in August and September produced no verifiable withdrawal plan. Public statements and deployments indicated that Azerbaijan believed a limited offensive could seize selected districts before international mediation froze the front. Armenia and Artsakh treated the same positions as non-negotiable depth. Their estimates of acceptable cost and the threshold for victory consequently moved in opposite directions.
impact: 軍事上，亞爾斯赫克的防禦縱深在短時間內縮短。阿格達姆、巴爾達、卡拉巴赫西部與馬爾塔克爾特周邊的大量陣地由亞塞拜然取得，亞美尼亞被迫從部分西部突出部撤出原有部隊，斯捷潘內克特與卡爾巴賈爾周邊的直接威脅因而出現，但亞塞拜然在2020年並未占領斯捷潘內克特，也未完整控制卡爾巴賈爾。外交上，俄羅斯由中立調解者轉為停火見證者與安全安排參與者，依協議最多派遣1,960名維和人員，前往亞爾斯赫克及拉欖走廊一帶；土耳其的無人機供應和監測角色也更為公開，但土耳其仍未成為地面交戰方。此次行動顯示，無人機觀察、砲兵隱蔽、通訊中斷、後備部隊反應時間與外線公路安全會直接影響山區防線，命中數輛坦克並不能單獨決定陣地得失。停火協議沒有處理亞爾斯赫克的最終地位，部分撤軍地點和交接程序又以停火時實際位置為基礎，這些未決問題在其後仍造成軍事接觸與再交火風險。
impactEn: Militarily, Artsakh's defensive depth was compressed in a short period. Azerbaijan gained extensive positions around Aghdam, Barda, western Qarabağ, and Martakert, forcing Armenia to withdraw forces from parts of its western salient. A direct threat to Stepanakert and the Kalbajar area emerged, although Azerbaijan did not capture Stepanakert or take complete control of Kalbajar in 2020. Diplomatically, Russia moved from neutral mediator to witness and security participant, with authority to deploy up to 1,960 peacekeepers to Artsakh and the Lachin corridor area under the agreement. Turkey's drone deliveries and monitoring role became more visible, but Turkey still did not become a ground belligerent. The campaign showed that drone observation, artillery concealment, communications disruption, reserve reaction time, and the security of roads behind the front directly affected a mountain defence. Destroying several tanks by itself could not determine control of positions. The ceasefire did not settle Artsakh's final status, and some withdrawal areas and handover procedures were based on the actual positions on the day fighting stopped. Those unresolved questions remained sources of military contact and renewed violence afterward.
result: 10月26日，扎基爾·胡塞因諾夫代表亞塞拜然、阿爾茨倫·薩爾基揚代表亞美尼亞、賈米爾·拜拉馬揚代表亞爾斯赫克，在俄羅斯外長謝爾蓋·拉夫羅夫見證下於莫斯科簽署停火安排。文件要求亞美尼亞與亞爾斯赫克部隊在十天期限內撤出卡爾巴賈爾、拉欖、庫巴德利、阿格達姆、傑布賴伊勒、菲祖利、贊吉蘭等劃定區域，以及賈姆賈附近的指定交接點；亞塞拜疆則保留戰前已控制及戰爭中取得的區域。交換俘虜與遺體、搜尋遺體、排雷、監察交接和防止違反停火成為主要執行事項。協議同時安排最多1,960名俄羅斯維和人員進入亞爾斯赫克及拉欖走廊相關地區，協助觀察停火與撤離線。領土結果是亞塞拜然保有巴爾達、阿格達姆以及卡拉巴赫和馬爾塔克爾特大部分已取得區域，但斯捷潘內克特與卡爾巴賈爾市仍在亞爾斯赫克控制之下，拉欖走廊也沒有依這份文件立即開通。這不是永久和平條約，沒有由亞美尼亞正式放棄對邊界或亞爾斯赫克地位的主張；停火後的俘虜交換和掃雷工作仍持續一段時間，但不應把這些執行程序改寫成10月26日後仍有主要戰役。
resultEn: On October 26, Zakir Huseynov signed for Azerbaijan, Artsrun Sargsyan for Armenia, and Jamil Bayramyan for Artsakh in Moscow, with Russian foreign minister Sergei Lavrov witnessing the arrangement. The document required Armenian and Artsakh forces to withdraw within ten days from designated areas including Kalbajar, Lachin, Qubadli, Aghdam, Jabrayil, Fuzuli, and Zangilan, together with specified handover points near Ganja. Azerbaijan was to retain areas it already controlled before the war and had captured during the fighting. Exchanges of prisoners and remains, recovery operations, mine clearance, monitoring of handovers, and prevention of ceasefire violations became the main implementation tasks. The agreement also provided for up to 1,960 Russian peacekeepers to enter Artsakh and areas related to the Lachin corridor to observe the ceasefire and withdrawal lines. Azerbaijan retained Barda, Aghdam, and most of the areas it had gained in Qarabağ and around Martakert, but Stepanakert and the town of Kalbajar remained under Artsakh control, and the Lachin corridor was not opened immediately under this document. This was not a final peace treaty, and Armenia did not formally relinquish its position on the boundary or the status of Artsakh. Prisoner exchanges and mine-clearance work continued for some time after October 26, but those implementation activities should not be recast as continuing major combat after the ceasefire.
